claim: Learn a plotter's layout, mask and exact figure pixels by running the original plotter on an empty (0x00) and a full (0xFF) canvas instead of decoding graphics or guessing the body.

evidence.text: First model of the figure's layout was wrong (the mask is a row and a byte larger and starts a pixel left); the game's own routine run on an empty and a full background showed the layout.
evidence.quote: the game's own routine run on an empty and a full background showed the layout.

evidence.text: The game's own routines run on an empty and a full screen gave the layout (byte order in a row, the empty rows, the mask's corner) at the first try; the model matched at every shift.
evidence.quote: The game's own routines run on an empty and a full screen gave the layout (byte order

evidence.text: Measured on f5000 with blank buffers 0x00 / 0xFF: the mask is a ~1 px outline built in pixel pairs; a morphological body leaves 49 mask pixels uncovered, so masks must come from the game.
evidence.quote: fill(close1(dilate1(ink)))) leaves 49 mask pixels uncovered -> masks must come from the game.

evidence.text: A masked graphic sits a row below and a pixel right of its mask's corner.
evidence.quote: a masked graphic sits a row below and a pixel right of its mask's corner
